card.name: Bisphosphonate and bone-drug context words
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "including", "on" or "of" right after a bisphosphonate or bone-drug mention in osteoporosis labels, where a specific drug name comes next.

modes.label: Including after bisphosphonates
modes.description: The word "including" or "includes" follows the class name bisphosphonates, just before a named drug.
modes.example: have been reported during treatment with bisphosphonates<< including>> ibandronate in patients with oste

modes.label: On or of after bone-drug terms
modes.description: A short linking word follows a bone-related drug or condition term in warning text.
modes.example: Patients who are suspected of having or who develop ONJ while<< on>> Bosaya should receive care by a dentist

modes.label: Inside drug name or dose
modes.description: The pole fires on part of an osteoporosis drug name or on a unit after its dose.
modes.example: Instruct patients to do the following: • Take<< r>>isedronate sodium tablets at least

card.writes: It pushes the model toward the word bone, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires on small words in osteoporosis drug text where the next idea is about bone.
